title: Amelia Earhart's Final Flight
hook: Amelia Earhart vanished over the Pacific in July 1937 during her round-the-world attempt. The unanswered distress call and missing wreck keep the case open.

beats.label: THE CASE
beats.line: In July 1937 Amelia Earhart vanished over the Pacific while attempting to reach Howland Island.

beats.label: CLUE 1
beats.line: The last transmission was a distress call at eight am, reporting low fuel and broken antenna.

beats.label: CLUE 2
beats.line: Investigators found a possible wreck on Nikumaroro Island, but the debris was inconclusive.

beats.label: CLUE 3
beats.line: A 2019 sonar survey detected a metallic object near the island, sparking renewed speculation.

beats.label: THE TWIST
beats.line: Some researchers argue the plane may have landed on Gardner Island, where Earhart lived for months.

end.line: What really happened to Earhart's plane over the Pacific?

description: Explore the enduring mystery of Amelia Earhart's disappearance.

facts.claim: Amelia Earhart disappeared in July 1937 while attempting to reach Howland Island
The last known radio transmission was at 8:43 am reporting low fuel and a broken antenna
A possible crash site on Nikumaroro (formerly Gardner Island) was investigated in the 1940s
A 2019 sonar survey detected a metallic object near Nikumaroro
Some researchers propose Earhart may have landed on Gardner Island and survived for months
